attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his own Substack post, stated in his own voice.

semantics.note: Faithful. It keeps the stronger 'no longer on board' for Hassabis, Sutskever and LeCun and the weaker 'hinted at skepticism' for Nadella and Pichai. It is a present-tense observation about public positions.

contract.note: Reading scaling as 'scaling existing methods alone is enough for AGI' is the ordinary reading in Marcus's context. The thresholds for each group are fair. The result turns on how 'no longer on board' is read for Hassabis, given his mixed remarks.

evidence.note: Dec 2025 report quotes Hassabis saying scaled current systems could be the entirety of AGI. That keeps scaling alone as a live route, despite his suspicion that one or two breakthroughs are needed.
Nov 2025 original transcript: Sutskever doubts that 100x scale would transform everything and says it is back to the age of research.
Jan 2026 report quotes LeCun saying that scaling or refining the current paradigm will not reach human-level intelligence.
Nov 2025 transcript: Nadella is optimistic about scaling laws but says some of it needs real science breakthroughs. That meets the weak 'hinted' threshold.
Dec 2024 Semafor interview: Pichai says progress is not just scaling alone but needs breakthroughs. That meets the 'hinted' threshold.
2023 Wired interview shows LeCun was already skeptical of scaling. That supports his current position but undercuts any suggestion of a recent change.

reviews.rationale: Sutskever (e2) and LeCun (e3) rejected scaling alone before publication, and Nadella (e4) and Pichai (e5) expressed some doubt, so those parts hold. For Hassabis, the latest packet evidence (e1, Dec 2025) has him saying scaled current systems could be the entirety of AGI. Under the contract's contradiction rule, that conflicts with saying he is no longer on board. The packet shows no earlier pro-scaling stance for LeCun, so the implied change is not shown.
